name: Financial statement audit
payer: Audited company pays the auditor; audit committee hires and fires (post-2002).
access: Full access to books, records, management, and staff under statute and professional standards.
publication: Auditor's opinion is public; working papers are confidential; PCAOB inspection reports partly public.
ai_analogue: The closest structural precedent for lab-paid evaluation. Independence was engineered by standards, inspection of auditors, rotation, and liability rather than by changing who pays.

milestones.event: UK Joint Stock Companies Act requires audited balance sheets; auditors need not be accountants.
Mandatory audit repealed; audit becomes voluntary for most companies.
ICAEW chartered; audits voluntary in the UK between 1856 and 1900.
UK Companies Act 1900 restores mandatory annual audit.
US Securities Act and 1934 Exchange Act require independent audits for listed companies after the 1929 crash.
Audited financial statements filed publicly with the SEC.
McKesson & Robbins fraud: auditors had not verified inventory or receivables.
milestones.trigger_criterion: Audit failed to detect fabricated inventory and receivables

milestones.event: First Statements on Auditing Procedure: physical inventory observation and receivables confirmation become required.
Audit firms' consulting revenue from audit clients overtakes audit fees at large firms.
Enron collapse; Arthur Andersen had provided audit and consulting services to the same client.
PCAOB registers and inspects audit firms.
Sarbanes-Oxley: PCAOB created to inspect auditors; audit and most consulting separated; lead partner rotation every five years; audit committee independence.
EU audit reform: mandatory firm rotation and a cap on non-audit fees for public-interest entities.

status: seed; secondary sources; verify each milestone against a primary source before citing in the paper

mechanisms.note: Audit committee of independent directors selects since 2002; PCAOB inspects auditors.
